title: Localizing Cross-Lingual Generalization in Parameter Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.31975v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Cross-lingual transfer is uneven across tasks, succeeding for natural language understanding but often failing for mathematical reasoning. We argue that this asymmetry is governed by the geometry of parameter space. Specifically, cross-lingual generalization is determined by whether English and target-language LoRA adapters share a low-error basin. To test this, we use linear mode connectivity (LMC) between English and target-language adapters, evaluating on three tasks. We find that NLI and QA model-language pairs are mostly linearly connected, whereas mathematical reasoning (Math) pairs are not, indicating that basin geometry is task-dependent. Such disconnection in Math is ``local'' rather than global. A small target-language task sample, applied only to the English adapter's language encoding or semantic composition layers, is enough to repair it. translated_title: 在参数空间中定位跨语言泛化
translated_abstract: 跨语言迁移在不同任务间的表现并不均衡：它在自然语言理解上往往成功，但在数学推理上常常失败。我们认为这种不对称性由参数空间的几何结构所决定。具体而言，跨语言泛化取决于英语与目标语言的LoRA适配器是否共享同一个低误差盆地。为验证这一观点，我们利用英语与目标语言适配器之间的线性模式连通性（LMC），在三个任务上进行评估。我们发现，NLI和QA任务对应的模型-语言对大多呈线性连通，而数学推理对应的对则不连通，这表明盆地几何结构依赖于任务类型。数学任务中的这种不连通是“局部的”而非全局的：仅需少量目标语言任务样本，且只应用于英语适配器的语言编码或语义组合层，就足以修复这种不连通。此外，跨语言泛化还可以被分解为语言特定编码与语义成分的组合（摘要原文在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文发现跨语言泛化的成败由参数空间几何决定，即英语与目标语言LoRA适配器是否共享低误差盆地，且数学推理任务中的局部不连通只需少量目标语言样本微调英语适配器的语言编码或语义组合层即可修复。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that cross-lingual generalization is governed by parameter-space geometry—whether English and target-language LoRA adapters share a low-error basin—and that the local disconnection observed in mathematical reasoning can be repaired by fine-tuning only the English adapter's language encoding or semantic composition layers with a few target-language samples.
